Guidelines and protocols: Establish clear guidelines and protocols for the appropriate use of AI chatbots in patient care.
Emphasize the complementary role of AI chatbots in supporting rather than replacing human judgment in clinical decision-making.
Define the roles and responsibilities of healthcare professionals when interacting with AI chatbots and outline scenarios where human intervention is necessary.
Implement mechanisms to monitor the impact of AI chatbots on patient care outcomes and healthcare workflows.

unlisted_practices: Foster critical thinking skills in healthcare professionals using AI chatbots.
Establish clear ethical guidelines for the use of AI chatbots in patient care and decision-making.
Conduct longitudinal and qualitative research on overreliance on AI chatbots among healthcare professionals and evaluate interventions to mitigate it.
